scripts.db:apply:temporary: for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.temporary.jsonc --remote --temporary --file \"$f\" || exit 1; done && wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.temporary.jsonc --remote --temporary --file db/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:preview-local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.preview.jsonc --local
scripts.db:seed:preview-local: wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.preview.jsonc --local --file db/seed.sql
